clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, young dwarves and gnome refugees train for service to Ironforge. Snow blankets the sheltered vale in Dun Morogh's southwestern heights, and Coldridge Pass is its lone route to the wider mountain realm.

Anvilmar is where new recruits learn to fight, move unseen, and wield sorcery. Veteran dwarven instructors train them alongside displaced gnome scholars. Beyond the hall, snow covers the valley floor, where boars and hungry winter wolves test the novices' skill at surviving the frontier. Sheer cliffs keep the vale apart from much of Dun Morogh's trade.

Frostmane trolls camp in the valley, including at Frostmane Hovel, and skirmish with mountaineers over their ancestral claims against dwarven encroachment. Rockjaw troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, the tunnel linking the valley to Kharanos. With the pass blocked, travelers and supplies cannot move freely between the valley and Ironforge, the mountain realm's high seat.
